#!/bin/sh
set -eu

    printf 'Usage: %s SOURCE DESTINATION\n' "$0" >&2

fi

cp --sparse=always -- "$1" "$2"

mv -f -- "$tmp" bin/copy-image
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
sed -n '1,120p' bin/copy-image

command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/sparse-image-copy
dest=verification-copy.img
if [ -e "$dest" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Refusing to overwrite pre-existing verification-copy.img' >&2
  exit 1
fi
source_before=$(sha256sum source.img | awk '{print $1}')
./bin/copy-image source.img "$dest"
cmp -s source.img "$dest"
first_size=$(stat -c %s "$dest")
first_blocks=$(stat -c %b "$dest")
first_alloc=$((first_blocks * 512))
printf 'first_copy size=%s blocks=%s allocated_bytes=%s cmp=identical\n' "$first_size" "$first_blocks" "$first_alloc"
[ "$first_size" -eq 67108864 ]
[ "$first_alloc" -lt 2097152 ]
truncate -s 83886080 "$dest"
printf 'pre_repeat_size=%s\n' "$(stat -c %s "$dest")"
./bin/copy-image source.img "$dest"
cmp -s source.img "$dest"
second_size=$(stat -c %s "$dest")
second_blocks=$(stat -c %b "$dest")
second_alloc=$((second_blocks * 512))
source_after=$(sha256sum source.img | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'repeat_copy size=%s blocks=%s allocated_bytes=%s cmp=identical\n' "$second_size" "$second_blocks" "$second_alloc"
printf 'source_before_sha256=%s\nsource_after_sha256=%s\n' "$source_before" "$source_after"
[ "$second_size" -eq 67108864 ]
[ "$second_alloc" -lt 2097152 ]
[ "$source_before" = "$source_after" ]
printf '%s\n' 'all_copy_checks=PASS'
